svg.title: NyankoFace shrink and color matrix
svg.desc: Ten logo directions compared at true 24 and 32 pixel surface sizes across light, dark, monochrome, and inverse variants.
svg.text: Every direction is checked as a mark, not only as a large illustration.
Pass target: recognizable silhouette at 24px, clean 1-color export, no thin strokes that collapse on favicon or navbar surfaces.
